headline: Sizeable but short-period SSE junk — catch the morning cross-off window.
today: There's size on it (peaks to 4ft) but it's short-period SSE with no real push, so expect mushy and inconsistent. Your window is the morning when the WNW goes cross-off and cleans it up before the late-morning high; work the incoming tide on a fish or groveler. Afternoon softens to a light cross and evening goes back onshore.

daysToWatch.note: NNW offshore dawn and morning, clean but small — knee-to-waist log session.
Prime SE angle with real long-period in the mix and light dawn winds — best home day of the week.
